question: In S1 the achromatic arm used the arithmetic mean of the 21 measured kernels. Its high-frequency OTF is 0.981x the chromatic band average (otf_control.json), so a reader can ask whether the S1 difference reflects band-independence or an unusually weak/strong mean-kernel blur. The 550 nm arm answers only that: it is band-independent like the mean arm, but carries a real measured band's frequency response instead of the average.

arm.name: s3a550
arm.construction: the 550 nm measured kernel replicated over all 21 bands (kind=band, make_achromatic_control.py)

data.split: 39 train / 9 val, frozen 14-scene test never opened

held_fixed_with_s1.model: A6 (model A, 6 stages, width 64, depth 4, 98139 parameters)
held_fixed_with_s1.noise_and_augmentation: unchanged from S1; noise std is this arm's own forward RMS x 0.005

primary.meaning: does the S1 chromatic-vs-achromatic result survive replacing the mean kernel with a real band's frequency response?

secondary.meaning: are the mean kernel and the 550 nm kernel distinguishable in training at all? quantified, not asserted

decision_rule.statistical_unit: seed (n = 3); the nine validation scenes inside a seed are direction evidence only
decision_rule.stable: all three seeds share the direction AND |mean delta| > max(cross-seed sd, plateau epoch-to-epoch std) AND every seed has at least 8 of 9 scenes in that direction
decision_rule.per_band: band_relative_l2 and band_rmse are reported as a separate dimension with the same three clauses; per-band plateau std is not available for these runs and is not substituted
decision_rule.budget_censored: a run that reaches the 400-epoch cap with its best epoch inside the final 60-epoch patience window

pre_registered_outcomes.A: s1c vs s3a550 reproduces the S1 direction and passes the rule: the S1 conclusion does not depend on the mean kernel's frequency response, and the mean-kernel OTF is ruled out as the explanation.
pre_registered_outcomes.B: s3a550 behaves like s3a within the rule and s1c vs s3a550 does not pass: the S1 achromatic disadvantage was a property of that particular averaged blur, and S1 must be restated as 'chromatic vs this mean-kernel blur' rather than 'chromatic vs achromatic'.
pre_registered_outcomes.C: neither: the 550 nm arm differs from both, so OTF shape cannot be excluded and no claim about the source of the S1 difference is made.
pre_registered_outcomes.note: all three outcomes are acceptable results; none is to be reframed after the fact

explicit_non_claims: this arm cannot test spectral information: a band-independent operator has identically zero response to a zero-sum spectral change (analytic identity, B1), and the 550 nm kernel is band-independent by construction
no frozen-test, hardware, material-recognition or end-to-end task claim follows from this arm
the 550 nm kernel is a derived control from the same measured set, not new PSF acquisition

environment.note: OMP/MKL/OPENBLAS threads pinned to 4 per process; run_arm.sh sets them
